sloka: पदातिनौ च यान अर्हाव् अदुह्ख अर्हौ सुख उचितौ ।दृष्ट्वा सम्चोदयाम् आस शीघ्रम् याहि इति सारथिम् ॥२-४०-४१॥
transliteration: padātinau ca yāna arhāv aduhkha arhau sukha ucitau ।dṛṣṭvā samcodayām āsa śīghram yāhi iti sārathim ॥2-40-41॥

translations.english: Seeing his parents, who were worthy of riding a chariot now going on foot, who were accustomed to comforts and did not deserve any suffering, Rama urged his charioteer to drive fast.
